articles.title: CVE-2026-93986 — CVSS 3.1
articles.summary: rclone before 1.75.1 fails to confine names from server and third-party listing responses to the listed directory, allowing path traversal sequences in object names. Attackers can craft special names containing forward slashes and parent directory references to potentially write outside the destination root, though downstream protections in the local backend currently block actual file escape.

articles.title: CVE-2026-93985 — CVSS 9.9

Attackers with project write access can create webhook templates using computed property notation to access Function constructor and execute arbitrary code in the worker process.

articles.title: CVE-2026-93984 — CVSS 5.3
